item.title: Iranian drone smashes into airfield at RAF Akrotiri as blast rocks British base - security alert declared

item.title: Oil prices skyrocket amid Iran crisis as tankers burn in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Oil prices have skyrocketed amid the conflict in Iran, with tankers burning on the waves and the Strait of Hormuz brought to a near standstill.The Iranian waterway, through which a fifth of all oil flows, was brought to a near-stop as Iran attacked several ships.Brent crude oil shot up to $77 USD (£57.28), an increase of 10 per cent.Meanwhile, investors fled to gold, an asset considered stable during times of crisis.
